_comment: Shared cross-impl test vector for the CAPAUTH_NONCE canonical payload. Python, PHP, and JS tests all read THIS file and assert their canonicalNoncePayload() produces byte-identical output. This is the single source of truth that prevents PHP-vs-Python (and JS) drift. Do not edit the expected_* fields without regenerating every impl's output.
